# Prop Connect

> Prop Connect is a digital platform that helps Nigerians safely search, verify, and acquire genuine landed properties from trusted agents.

Prop Connect connects buyers and renters with verified real estate agents across Nigeria. The platform enforces KYC verification, escrow-backed transactions, AI-guided chat safety, and an admin-reviewed property approval workflow to reduce real estate fraud.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Prop Connect, featured properties, and how the platform works.
- [Properties](/properties): Browse verified landed properties for sale and rent across Nigeria.
- [Agents](/agents): Directory of verified real estate agents with trust scores and KYC badges.
- [Announcements](/announcements): Latest platform announcements and new listings.
- [Analytics](/analytics): Public market analytics and trends.
- [Investing in Nigerian Real Estate](/guides/investing-in-nigeria): Guide covering property types, the Land Use Act, and ROI in major Nigerian cities.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Platform terms and conditions.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How user data is collected, stored, and protected.

## Optional

- [Log In](/login): Sign in to an existing account.
- [Sign Up](/register): Create a buyer, agent, or builder account.
